summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of the First Tranche of its new buyback program, having reached the €1,000 million maximum. The bank acquired 40,204,840 own shares, roughly 0.73% of share capital, with HSBC Continental Europe acting as manager; the final October 1 transactions were disclosed. Shares are to be redeemed, reducing share capital, per the July 30, 2026 inside-information notice. The program was notified under EU MAR. Watch redemption timing and any subsequent tranches, which affect share count and EPS accretion.
